description: This file defines the Length class within the Opencart System Library for Cart, providing functionalities such as unit conversion, formatting, and retrieval of length measurement units. It interacts with the database to load length units and supports conversion between different length standards.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: A class handling length unit conversions, formatting, and retrieval of measurement units within the Cart library of the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Length class by loading length units from the database based on current language settings.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one unit to another based on stored unit data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value into a string with appropriate unit; includes number formatting with specified decimal and thousand separators.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string (e.g., 'cm', 'inch') for a given length class ID.
